name: Alchemist Apprentice Boots
description: Simple leather boots-a perfect fit.

name: Alchemist Apprentice Chest
description: A comfortable, traditional garb suiting an upcoming alchemist.

name: Alchemist Apprentice Gloves
description: tarting out on the path of the alchemist apprentice, these gloves will make your life a little more comfortable.

name: Alchemist Apprentice Hat
description: Providing general protection and shade, the alchemist's apprentice hat is perfect for wandering around the world.

name: Alchemist Apprentice Trousers
description: Comfortable trousers for long walks.

name: Archmage Boots
description: These boots were made by the most talented cobblers and are as expensive as they come.

name: Archmage Chest
description: A truly spirited garb for magicians and casters. The fabric was laboriously dyed with deep cobalt pigment derived from imported nightblooms.

name: Archmage Gloves
description: Gloves which were worn by the most talented, renowned and successful mages of the kingdom.

name: Archmage Hat
description: This magical hat was decorated with fine metal spines that reach out to the stars. It only graces the brightest minds in Embervale!

name: Archmage Trousers
description: The pants are elegantly held together with cobalt stitching and thread. The color represents sophistication and the superiority of the mind.

name: Elder Boots
description: The design of these boots imitates the skin of wyverns. Their scales were rumored to have the exceptional ability to absorb magical energy from all around!

name: Elder Chest
description: This armor was conceived to restrain and control the wearer's smoldering magical energy within. If worn by a mere apprentice rather than an elder, it could make their heart stop!

name: Elder Gloves
description: All the forgotten knowledge of the world will be at your fingertips with these highly sought - after gloves.

name: Elder Hat
description: The past, present, and future all unfold in front of your eyes like blooming aureolins when observed through this helmet.

name: Elder Trousers
description: Magnificent pants, word by the most battle hardened and sagacious wizards.

name: Hailcaster Boots
description: These boots provide resistance and grip when stuck in a fierce snowstorm.

name: Hailcaster Chest
description: A carefully layered tunic, tied over the chest with gold string. The cloth is thick, but flowy. It will enable quick magical dashes while protecting you from the bitter cold.

name: Hailcaster Gloves
description: Simple layered gloves that allow for optimal versatility and swiftness when spellcasting.

name: Hailcaster Hat
description: A sophisticated crown that frames the wearer's head with a golden halo and amethyst sparks. It represents the dawning sun, bathing the mountainsides in a long-awaited morning glow.

name: Hailcaster Pants
description: Dark padded pants with golden seams. They're warm and comfortable.

name: Healer Boots
description: No need to keep these boots clean and neat. They will get bloody. Your teammates will make sure of that.

name: Healer Gloves
description: These gloves allow nimble fingers to patch up wounds in a pinch.

name: Healer Headwrap
description: A headwrap that protects your sensitive skull from traumatic injury. Enough to postpone the inevitable for a while.

name: Healer Pants
description: Woven pants which keep the wearer from scraping their knees.

name: Healer Tunic
description: A breathable tunic with ample space for bandages, herbs, and tissues.

name: Herbalist Boots
description: Quickly dash to the rescue in these comfortable and snug boots !

name: Herbalist Gloves
description: These fingerless gloves allow the weaver to feel each leaf and root before picking, allowing a proper assessment.

name: Herbalist Headwrap
description: Headgear for herbalists. Healing others is suprisingly hard when you can't actually see them.

name: Herbalist Pants
description: Some plain herbalist pants. They smell like rosemary and thyme.

name: Herbalist Tunic
description: Classic herbalist garb with widened pockets for storing healing tinctures.

name: Mage Boots
description: Light boots. They're slightly pointed at the toes.

name: Mage Chest
description: This garment is held together by oakwood buttons, a woven belt, and magic itself! The buttons are doing most of the work, though.

name: Mage Gloves
description: Artificial nails were added to these otherwise simple mage gloves to make them more imposing and fashionable.

name: Mage Hat
description: No mage armor set is complete without a large, brimmed hat.

name: Mage Trousers
description: These comfortable and plain pants are perfect for apprentices who wish to gather some firsthand adventuring experience.

name: Magician Boots
description: Low - cut shoes. Exposing one's ankles is quite enchanting !

name: Magician Chest
description: An ordinary shirt, covered partially by a more sophisticated jacket.

name: Magician Gloves
description: A magician's gloves, bound by a magic - infused golden thread.

name: Magician Hat
description: This magician's headgear frames the wearer's face with a luscious golden trim.

name: Magician Trousers
description: These pants were made from silky smooth cloth, gracing only the most esteemed magicians.

name: Mystic Boots
description: Elegant boots with blue accents. They exude glamour and grace.

name: Mystic Chest
description: An exquisite mystical coat made of fine, dyed material. The metal clasps alone are highly valuable.

name: Mystic Gloves
description: Mystical gloves that have been adorned with glistening aquamarine stones.

name: Mystic Hat
description: A Wizard Hat. Most commonly worn during lunar ceremonies and divinations.

name: Mystic Pants
description: A pair of proper trousers. The metal delicate accents around the waist resembles the moon and the tide.

name: Omen Boots
description: Unknown footprints in the mud are always a bad omen, whether one is superstitious or not., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Omen Chest
description: An ordinary leather coat. A fungal growth overtook the flat grain texture., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Omen Gloves
description: Gloves made from rotting, undead matter. They claw at their wearer's upper arms as if to grow upwards.

name: Omen Helmet
description: A living shell to encase the wearer's face like an iron maiden., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Omen Trousers
description:
Dark chestnut-colored pants. They're less frayed and battered than the remainder of the Omen's armor.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Pearlfrost Mentor Boots
description: Tied dark leather boots with quilted fabric sections. They reach up to the wearer's knees, protecting the shins from deep snow.

name: Pearlfrost Mentor Chest
description: It's an expertly layered blue coat with a white fur trim. The quilted cloth and leather provide better protection in close combat. The gold casing near the heart carries a faceted gem and resembles a cornflower blue eye, searching the battlefield for souls in need.

name: Pearlfrost Mentor Gloves
description: With these padded gloves, you can easily scale any cliff to reach snowed-in souls in need

name: Pearlfrost Mentor Hat
description: When wounded warriors see this hat peak up from the horizon, they know salvation is near. Then they notice that the hat is a little bit cone-shaped. They usually don't say anything about it, though.

name: Pearlfrost Mentor Pants
description: A pair of warm pants, tinged in a deep blue. It provides ample protection from the elements.

name: Sage Boots
description: Comfortable and modest shoes for lounging in library.

name: Sage Gloves
description: In old times these gloves were worn by the wisest scholars of the kingdom, often hiding wrinkled and gray flesh underneath.

name: Sage Headwrap
description: You can't read sacred scrolls if you can't see, but true understanding comes from within, anyway.

name: Sage Pants
description: Remarkable pants. What makes them remarkable? The weaver, mostly.

name: Sage Tunic
description: An illustrious garb that almost shines brighter than the wearer's spirit.

name: Spellbreaker Boots
description: Ground yourself, and feel the earth beneath your feet. Connect to the magical core of the world with these graceful boots.

name: Spellbreaker Chest
description: The inner lining of this coat follow the direction of the body's veins, allowing for easier magic channeling.

name: Spellbreaker Gloves
description: With these gloves, all the magic of the world can easily flow through you and into the tips of your fingers.

name: Spellbreaker Hat
description: This magical spellbinder's hat has been adorned with an azure gem. It attracts lingering or scattered fragments of the Flame and stores them for improved spellcasting.

name: Spellbreaker Pants
description: A pair of pants. They're breezier than they look, allowing you to feel the wind.

name: Thaumaturge Boots
description: A well-fitted pair of boots to round off the Thaumaturge armor set. The purple accents create a balanced overall look.

name: Thaumaturge Chest
description: This chest piece includes a silky white undergarment for warmth and a flowy cerulean cape for further insulation, and dramatic effect.

name: Thaumaturge Gloves
description: Elaborate armguards that shield the wearer from snow, rime, and grime. An amethyst has been inserted into the gem slot, enabling a better mana flow when spellcasting.

name: Thaumaturge Hat
description: An extravagantly exaggerated tricorn hat that shields the caster's head from snowfall. The imposing antlers are a wearable trophy representing the wearer's spirit animal.

name: Thaumaturge Pants
description: This pair of pants has significant padding on the inside, allowing you to travel for longer periods in frost-ridden lands. Traditionally, hides from the wearer's spirit animal are used to create the padding, but wool will do in a pinch.

name: Tidecaller Gloves
description: They don't offer much protection, but enhance your magical abilities. The minimalist design also prevents you from getting sweaty hands.

name: Tidecaller Headpiece
description: A striking, extravagant headpiece, just as broad as your magical abilities -- but you might get stuck in the doorway.

name: Tidecaller Pants
description: Those pants go perfectly with the tunic, creating a fluent transition. They allow enough air circulation to prevent overheating during battle.

name: Tidecaller Shoes
description: Stride forth in these shoes, as swiftly as your mana regenerates.

name: Tidecaller Tunic
description: A light tunic, as majestic in appearance as the powers it bestows when you spread your arms wide.

name: Warlock Boots
description: Traditional warlock boots which protect the feet and allow the wearer to stampede over enemy remains.

name: Warlock Gloves
description: Both spells and smiting blows are easily dealt with these marvelous warlock gloves.

name: Warlock Helmet
description: A helmet which protects your sensitive cranial bone from harm while riding into battle.

name: Warlock Pants
description: Historic pants, formerly the centerpiece of ceremonial warlock clothing.

name: Warlock Shirt
description: A traditional garment which was historically worn by esteemed battle mages. Now, their ritualistic nature is a faint memory at best.

name: Waveborne Ritualist Boots
description: With this footwear, the healing power of the earth flows straight through you -- can you feel it?

name: Waveborne Ritualist Gloves
description: Golden adornments define this set -- and naturally, the gloves are no exception.

name: Waveborne Ritualist Helmet
description: The mask veils the face, but not the intent. You are here to keep one safe.

name: Waveborne Ritualist Pants
description: With their simplicity, these pants bring balance to the outfit and allow the wearer's presence to shine.

name: Waveborne Ritualist Tunic
description: A magnificent aquamarine gleams upon this garment, said to amplify the wearer's healing abilities.

name: Wizard Boots
description: Remain steadfast when smiting your foes from afar with these formidable wizard boots

name: Wizard Chest
description: Protects the wearer from stray sparks, sudden cold flashes, and unplanned fiery explosions.

name: Wizard Gloves
description: A dark and dreary set of gloves. They make spellcasting feel ominous!

name: Wizard Hat
description: Some farmers believe that wizards store their magical energy in their brimmed hats. These rumors were widespread but false. Mostly.

name: Wizard Pants
description: Dark pants for dark magic wielders.

name: Adventurer Boots
description: These boots are perfect for any terrain. Easy to clean, robust, and light.

name: Adventurer Chest
description: Warm, light, and agile. This piece of armor is a great fit for adventurers! The red scarf is especially daring.

name: Adventurer Gloves
description: Sturdy gloves that protect the hands while exploring. The red markings on them represent bravery.

name: Adventurer Helmet
description: A simple but reliable helmet. You still might get a bump or two if you get hit, but that's part of the fun.

name: Adventurer Trousers
description: No matter how they may wear and tear, these pants can always be patched up again! That makes them suitable for bold explorers.

name: Blackguard Boots
description: A warrior's boots that used to brandish a golden sheen. They've dulled due to the fungal overgrowth., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Blackguard Chest
description: A metal cuirass with subtle embossing on it. The pattern is reminiscent of golden tangled vines, now spouting with delicate mycelium., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Blackguard Gloves
description: Reinforced gloves with makeshift chitin plating.

name: Blackguard Helmet
description: A helmet made from petrified insectoid critter legs assembled to grasp at the wearer's face like claws., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Blackguard Trousers
description: A pair of rotting pants, held together by stabilizing chitin shells., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Brazen Bull Boots
description: No one will get through you whilst you stand your ground in these regal boots.

name: Brazen Bull Chest
description: If anyone dares to engage you in close combat, they'll get a taste of your wildly thrashing spiked shoulder pads. Your defense will be impenetrable, and the cuts you'll leave will be deep.

name: Brazen Bull Gloves
description: Catching a backhand from these spiked gloves will bring even the most vigilant attacker to their knees.

name: Brazen Bull Helmet
description: A heavy helmet, adorned with the imposing horns of a bull and a tall, far-reaching crest. The faceplate only leaves room for the eyes, letting the wearer's red-hot anger radiate outwards.

name: Brazen Bull Trousers
description: These leg guards protect the wearer's sides from incoming strikes.

name: Elite Hollow Boots
description: These boots are enhanced with metal plates, providing more defense to the sensitive shins of the skeletons wearing them.

name: Elite Hollow Chest Plate
description: A combination of rust-red fabric, metal plates, and gold accents. The latter usually matches the Hollow's gold teeth!

name: Elite Hollow Gloves
description: Heavy gloves, usually carried by bony or rotting ice-cold fingers.

name: Elite Hollow Helmet
description: An extravagant helmet with red plumes, traditionally worn by high-ranking army commanders.

name: Elite Hollow Pants
description: Cloth pants that are ripped and torn. A keen eye can spot sprinkles of died blood on them.

name: Gloom Monarch Boots
description: These boots seemingly once belonged to a ruler who's name has been lost to time. It faded into oblivion, leaving only a title and lingering curse.

name: Gloom Monarch Chestplate
description: A fearsome chest piece. It's rumored to have belonged to a fallen warrior whose name is never spoken out loud.

name: Gloom Monarch Gloves
description: Legends say that these gloves once belonged to a dark ruler whose name has been wiped from the history books.

name: Gloom Monarch Helmet
description: It's said that the original owner of this helmet wore it to hide his many facial scars. Whether this is true is uncertain.

name: Gloom Monarch Trousers
description: This forgotten piece of armor is covered in dried blood and shrouded in darkness. Maybe it should have stayed lost.

name: Guard of the North Boots
description: Sodden boots that strode through the knee-high snow of Cold Heights under foreboding northern lights. After marching through countless midnight hours, Lord Vorgoth finally reached the gates of Pikemead's Reach, weapon raised high.

name: Guard of the North Chestplate
description: Untouched by the Flame, and veiled in a lingering cold. This armor used to belong to Lord Vorgroth, who was rumored to have a frozen heart that splinters and breaks with every tired beat.

name: Guard of the North Gloves
effect: - 1 min Maximum time in the Shroud
description: Wearing these gloves, the Northern Lord carved his way through the enshrouded valleys of Embervale. The scars he cut into people and soil can be traced from Cold Heights's bleak mountains to today's ruins of Pikemead's Reach.

name: Guard of the North Helmet
description: Very few people witnessed the sharp, crystalline breath escaping Vorgoth from under the helmet firsthand. They saw his howl dance in the haze and felt it shiver down their skin, creep into their mind, and twist around their bones. Many did not live to tell the tale.

name: Guard of the North Pants
description: Pants that were formerly worn by soldiers of Lord Vorgoth, oldest son to Queen Pikemead. Legends say he was consumed by the Shroud after the Ancients pushed him off Howling Pike's summit.

name: Guardian Boots
description: Hefty boots. They will leave considerable footprints in the ground when you defend those in need.

name: Guardian Chestplate
description: Prodigious tin armor. The glistening sheen inspires hope.

name: Guardian Gloves
description: Big and bulky gloves, usually worn when wielding large weaponry and shields.

name: Guardian Helmet
description: Seeing this helmet makes others feel safe and secure.

name: Guardian Trousers
description: Trousers that were made from a very stiff material.

name: Knight Boots
description: A knight's boots. They've seen much peril and anguish.

name: Knight Chestplate
description: A knight's chestplate. It has a fading heroic aura.

name: Knight Gloves
description: Royal gloves, befitting a true knight of honor.

name: Knight Helmet
description: The helmet of a long - forgotten knight. With a bit of polish, it will be as good as new.

name: Knight Trousers
description: Knightly pants. The cloth attached brandishes a glorious golden thread.

name: Mercenary Boots
description: Some scratched up Mercenary Boots. Kick your enemies when they're down !

name: Mercenary Chest
description: A heavy breastplate that has lost its shine, but not its notoriety.

name: Mercenary Gloves
description: Mercenary Gloves. They're worth their weight in gold.

name: Mercenary Helmet
description: This sturdy Mercenary Helmet protects your eyes and hides your expression, making you appear fearless and intimidating.

name: Mercenary Trousers
description: A piece of leg armor that already looks like it has seen many years of use.

name: Mountain's Shadow Boots
description: These boots repeat the same weaving technique from the Mountain's Shadow Gloves. They cover the knees and provide ideal protection when stumbling through dark, icy caves or forgotten fortresses.

name: Mountain's Shadow Chest
description: No matter where you turn, the celestial crags of the mountainside always crast a dark shadow over the valleys. With this piece of armor, you can blend into the dark and travel lightly like a freezing gust of wind to find your enemies.

name: Mountain's Shadow Gloves
description: Dark leather patterned arm guards wrapped in ashen grey strings. Wool padding peeks out from beneath them when wielding your weapon fiercly.

name: Mountain's Shadow Helmet
description: A gloomy helmet, hiding an even darker gaze. The crest around the brow casts a shadow over the wearer's eyes, hiding their intention.

name: Mountain's Shadow Trousers
description: A pair of charcoal black, loosely fitted pants. The larger silhouette stems from the extensive wool padding inside.

name: Radiant Paladin Boots
description: Expertly crafted boots. They've been embellished with flame-spouting shields, a roaring inferno only kept at bay through vigilance.

name: Radiant Paladin Chestplate
description: Showcase your beaming soul of flames and cast out all evil once and for all! The light thunders and roars with every heartbeat.

name: Radiant Paladin Gloves
description: These gloves radiate warmth and safety as if they were forged in pure liquid light.

name: Radiant Paladin Helmet
description: A brightly burning visage graces this helmet, setting both the battlefield and hearts alike ablaze.

name: Radiant Paladin Trousers
description: This pair of trousers looks plain at first glance, but the craftsmanship allows the wearer to produce and retain more warmth from within.

name: Rising Fighter Boots
description: Footwork is the most important skill of swordsmanship. These boots should make learning the first steps easier.

name: Rising Fighter Chest
description: Light, polstered and ready to take a few hits - the perfect chest armor for begginer.

name: Rising Fighter Gloves
description: Gloves made for beginner fighters. Robust, but agile. They will mainly protect you from blisters when swinging your sword.

name: Rising Fighter Helmet
description: A head piece to keep your skull safe when diving into battle.

name: Rising Fighter Trousers
description: Polstered trousers to dampen your fall in fighting practice.

name: Rogue Boots
description: Adventures who wear these fearsome boots should not be messed with.

name: Rogue Chestplate
description: A well - balanced chest piece that lets the wearer regenerate their energy faster.

name: Rogue Gloves
description: Protects the fingers from traps and cuts. A rogue's best friend !

name: Rogue Helmet
description: A sturdy helmet that protects the wearer from slashes, cuts and scars.

name: Rogue Trousers
description: The metal plates provide added protection against jagged or poisoned arrows.

name: Soldier Boots
description: A pair of boots which is covered in silvery scales. Your ankles will be safe and sound with these.

name: Soldier Chestplate
description: This regal soldier's armor symbolizes chivalry, glory, and valor.

name: Soldier Gloves
description: Few enemies can withstand even an unarmed blow dealt with these gloves.

name: Soldier Helmet
description: A finely crafted helmet, usually worn by the kingdom's most feared warriors and generals.

name: Soldier Trousers
description: Thick and reliable pants. Not very breathable, unfortunately.

name: Tank Boots
description: A shiny pair of boots. They're so heavy that you'll practically be immovable when wearing them.

name: Tank Chestplate
description: The improved copper coating of this Tank Chestplate can withstand many more blows at the frontlines of battle.

name: Tank Gloves
description: Copper - plated gloves that protect the wearer's tender hands during a brawl.

name: Tank Helmet
description: A copper helmet that keeps your skull from harm while you protect your allies.

name: Tank Trousers
description: These padded trousers have been hastily stitched at the seams. Despite that, they hold up well.

name: Warden Boots
description: No one can tread past you when you're wearing these steadfast boots.

name: Warden Chestplate
description: An incredibly sturdy chest piece, often worn by generals or select members of the royal guard. It inspired fear as much as respect.

name: Warden Gloves
description: Heavy gloves that can swing any weapon with added might.

name: Warden Helmet
description: Command respect with this Warden Helmet.

name: Warden Trousers
description: Gray pants which have been refined with expertly crafted metal parts.

name: Warrior Arms
description: The metal parts on these reinforced gloves are bent from one too many reckless swings

name: Warrior Boots
description: These boots were designed to allow for reckless charges and dashes. The metal tips at the front prevent you from stubbing your toes.

name: Warrior Chest
description: Risky but agile upper body armor. At least your shoulders will be safe from harm with these impressive spaulders!

name: Warrior Helmet
description: Dive headfirst into battle with this Warrior Helmet!

name: Warrior Trousers
description: The pieces that cover the sides of these pants have been carefully forged to defend against flanking attacks.

name: Wolf's Fang Boots
description: These spiked boots can cause a lot of damage when used to pierce arteries in one, swift swinging kick.

name: Wolf's Fang Chest
description: A robust chest piece, adorned with the fur of a white wolf. The colors blend in well with snowed-in, grey mountains.

name: Wolf's Fang Gloves
description: Silver-framed metal gloves with elaborate finger plates. The fingertip covers sharpen at the end into claw-like points.

name: Wolf's Fang Hood
description: A hood fashioned from the scalp of a white wolf. The fangs at the front are still attached.

name: Wolf's Fang Trousers
description: A pair of pants with leather greaves. They don't rustle while moving and muffle every little sound while sneaking around.

name: Diving Helmet
description:
A silver helmet that increases your maximum oxygen while diving. 

Its delicate engraved lines imitate the flow of water, and the viewport is segmented like a clam's shell.

name: Fur Boots
description: Warmer and sturdier than simple cloth.

name: Fur Chest
description: Reinforced with Metal Scraps for better protection.

name: Fur Gloves
description: Simple but reliable protection for hands.

name: Fur Hood
description: Simplistic head protection. It won't guard against much, but it's better than nothing.

name: Fur Trousers
description: A little archaic, but better than cloth.

name: Ragged Boots
description: They can barely be called boots.

name: Ragged Pants
description: Enough to brace for the worst of it, until better armor crosses your path.

name: Ragged Shirt
description: Can this even be called a shirt?

name: Threadbare Pants
description: A very basic set of garments.

name: Wanderer's Boots
description: A wanderer's boots, worn but still sturdy enough to carry your burdens on your journey.

name: Alpine Antler Boots
description: A light pair of boots that allow for swift movements when wading through snow and blizzards. You can scout the frozen fringes of the mountains for miles when wearing these shoes!

name: Alpine Antler Chest
description: A blue overcoat with a fluffy, snow-white trim to keep warm. The pelts are lightweight and won't weigh you down when scaling the mountain tops to find vantage points.

name: Alpine Antler Gloves
description: A pair of thick gloves, stuffed with warm, white fur. The area around the back of the wrist is shielded with a small metal plate.

name: Alpine Antler Hood
description: A fur hood that protects the wearer's face from the strong, cutting mountain winds.

name: Alpine Antler Trousers
description: A simple pair of brown leather pants that connect well to the corresponding undergarments for the torso.

name: Archer Boots
description: Woodland boots made of carefully layered leather straps.

name: Archer Chest
description: The leather on this nature - bound armor piece was layered to resemble the leaves of a blossoming forest.

name: Archer Gloves
description: These Archer gloves have been refined to be snug and effective.

name: Archer Helmet
description: An archer's hood. The leather trim provides additional protection and camouflages the wearer between the trees

name: Archer Trousers
description: The coloring of these pants allow the wearer to seamlessly blend into the foliage.

name: Assassin Boots
description: Your steps will be quick and quiet, and your strikes will be deadly.

name: Assassin Chest
description: A refined chest piece that lets you fade into the dark and strike from the shadows.

name: Assassin Gloves
description: Robust gloves that hide the wearer's palms and true intentions.

name: Assassin Hood
description: A special piece of cloth was added to this assassin hood to hide the wearer's face and their most likely daunting smile.

name: Assassin Trousers
description: A plain pair of pants. Under different circumstances, they would allow the wearer to easily blend into any crowd.

name: Bloodfeather Chest
description: With this chest piece, you can cut through the woods with ease, remaining undetected as you prepare your next strike.

name: Bloodfeather Gloves
description: Adorned with a crystal and gold trip, these gloves give you a firm grip on your daggers - ideal for strikes from behind.

name: Bloodfeather Helmet
description: The head armor combines a mask, cloth, and horns. For most foes, it will be the last thing they see when you catch them by surprise.

name: Bloodfeather Pants
description: Designed for stealth, these natural pants make sneaking through the thicket effortless.

name: Bloodfeather Shoes
description: With these shoes, maintain your stance and recover before launching your next attack.

name: Deadeye Boots
description: These boots are perfect for keeping a stable stance while aiming, shooting, and killing.

name: Deadeye Gloves
description: Your shots will always find their mark with these gloves.

name: Deadeye Hood
description: This archery hood lets you watch over the peaks and valleys like a hawk. Nothing will escape your vigilant gaze !

name: Deadeye Trousers
description: These pants are extremely light and therefore enable quick and flexible movements. Crouch, climb, and run to gain an advantage !

name: Deadeye Vest
description: Duck, dodge, and roll out of harm's way with this lightweight vest.

name: Deerstalker Boots
description: Stalking prey in these boots makes barely any sound. None will hear you coming.

name: Deerstalker Chest
description: Every movement is softened and muted whilst clad in this upper body armor.

name: Deerstalker Gloves
description: Firing an arrow with these gloves is effortless, creating a silky smooth stream of movement for the wearer.

name: Deerstalker Hood
description: The cloth straps attached to this mask glide softly in the breeze, helping to discern wind direction and speed.

name: Deerstalker Trousers
description: Warm and padded hunting pants that will retain your body heat during cold, starless nights.

name: Eagle Eye Boots
description: Wrapped in darkened leather and shrouded in mystery, these boots carry the wearer as if on clouds.

name: Eagle Eye Chest
description: The bright adornment on this armor piece shines brightly and aims to honor the glorious Flame.

name: Eagle Eye Gloves
description: Blessed by the Flame and bathed in the glorious light, these gloves will ensure that your every strike is guided by the Ancients themselves.

name: Eagle Eye Helmet
description: This hood further enhances your sight and lets your gaze burn hotter than a thousand suns.

name: Eagle Eye Trousers
description: The faded cool hue of these pants provides stark contrast to the flaming accents on the rest of the armor set.

name: Fowler Boots
description: Wearing these boots makes each step feel like you're being carried on silver wings

name: Fowler Chest
description: The details on this piece of upper body armor were greatly inspired by wing feathers.

name: Fowler Gloves
description: These improved archery gloves make it easier to shoot birds out of the sky ! There are hardly any birds these days, though.

name: Fowler Helmet
description: Remain keen - eyed as a hawk with this eerie hood.

name: Fowler Trousers
description: Green pants which allow the wearer to glide through tall grass swiftly and silently.

name: Frostbite Slasher Boots
description: Heavy boots with metal caps, perfect for kicking down doors or crushing skulls under your heel.

name: Frostbite Slasher Chest
description: A breezy west layered on top of a long shirt. The additional belt buckle strapped across the chest holds some spare blades.

name: Frostbite Slasher Gloves
description: Padded gloves made from thick white cloth and deep blue leather arm guards. A small buckle and cyan string hold them together. The fingertips are left bare, so you can still feel the pulse of the hunt.

name: Frostbite Slasher Hood
description: The fearsome metal mask is only partially covered by the hood, leaving most of its sharp edges and lines visible to your prey.

name: Frostbite Slasher Trousers
description: This pair of pants has ample space for carrying exposed blades and hidden toxins.

name: Hawk Boots
description: Ride as swift as the bluejays with these sturdy leather boots.

name: Hawk Chest
description: A formidable chest piece, decorated with many elements resembling nature, vines and petals

name: Hawk Gloves
description: Reliable gloves which shield the wearer's arms from claws.

name: Hawk Helmet
description: This hood includes an iron facemask which was greatly inspired by owls.

name: Hawk Trousers
description: Pants such as these were originally made fashionable by prominent falconers from ages long past.

name: Hunter Boots
description: These boots are ideal for stalking prey.

name: Hunter Gloves
description: These leather gloves have been adorned with metal to protect the weaver's knuckles.

name: Hunter Hood
description: Remain unseen and strike from the shadows with this formidable archer's hood.

name: Hunter Trousers
description: Nothing is more suitable for a long prowl than this set of pants.

name: Hunter Vest
description: Taking down prey, and even other predators, is far easier with this finely made hunter's armor.

name: Marksman Boots
description: The Reinforced soles allow the wearer to skulk through mud undisturbed, and to reach vantage points quickly. Perfect for an ambush!

name: Marksman Gloves
description: These gloves prevent the bowstring from digging into the skin while lining up shots.

name: Marksman Hood
description: A darkened hood which lets you blend into the woodland scenery more easily. A piece of red cloth covers the mouth, making you feel like a bandit.

name: Marksman Trousers
description: The added leather grants superior protection from jagged rocks, unruly tree bark, and incoming arrows.

name: Marksman Vest
description: A warm, padded vest. Ideal for enduring cold nights while awaiting the time to strike.

name: Plaguebringer Boots
description: These boots are always damp, even on the inside. Walking in them feels like wading through a bog., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Plaguebringer Chest
description: Countless cankerous growths sprout from this leather armour, thus forging it in a new image., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Plaguebringer Gloves
description: These traditional archer gloves were made asymmetrical through multiple monstrous tusks and bone shards jutting outwards.

name: Plaguebringer Hood
description: Putrescence laps the side of this brown hood, like a wave of pestilence crashing to shore., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Plaguebringer Trousers
description: Leather pants with noticeable grain that morphs into fine fungal tendrils., , Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

name: Ranger Boots
description: These boots were made for those wishing to lurk quietly through the thicket.

name: Ranger Gloves
description: Simple gloves made from ethically sourced organic leather.

name: Ranger Hood
description: A hood that provides additional protection from the sun, allowing you to focus your gaze undisturbed.

name: Ranger Trousers
description: Pants which shield the legs from brambles and thorns while hunting down prey.

name: Ranger Vest
description: This piece of armor only offers minor protection against incoming arrows, but that hardly matters. The best preventative measure is to aim for the eyes.

name: Scout Boots
description: The path of the scout is a little easier on quiet soles.

name: Scout Chest
description: A simple, light chest piece to complement the rest of the armor.

name: Scout Gloves
description: Excellent tools to scout with - especially due to their grip and padding.

name: Scout Hood
description: The perfect disguise - even in broad daylight.

name: Scout Pants
description: Silent pants to tread quietly.

name: Sharpshooter Boots
description: With these weighted soles, even shaky or uneven ground will not disturb your aim.

name: Sharpshooter Gloves
description: Wearing these gloves makes the pulse slow down mysteriously before going in for the kill, thus steadying the hands.

name: Sharpshooter Hood
description: The metal adorment on this hood faintly resembles the beak of a hawk.

name: Sharpshooter Trousers
description: The pants were made from varied materials and protect all the most important areas adequately.

name: Sharpshooter Vest
description: The shoulder pads on this Sharpshooter Vest are exceptionally sharp and pointed like the tip of an arrow.

name: Trailblazer Boots
description: These heavy boots provide excellent resistance and enable a stronger stance when facing various behemoths.

name: Trailblazer Chest
description: This armor piece was made from a combination of soft materials and hard, scale-like plating to ensure the ultimate flow of movement and protection. It has small hunting trophies attached to various spaces.

name: Trailblazer Gloves
description: Sturdy gloves, dark as the midnight sky. They've been adorned with animal horns that were gathered during the hunt.

name: Trailblazer Hood
description: The metal rim around this hood forms an elegant crown, jagging out from the wearer's skull. The shape of the tips is reminiscent of wings.

name: Trailblazer Trousers
description: Pants made from deep blue cloth and patched leather. The layers on the inside provide good insulation against the bitter cold.
